library_id.label: Library
library_id.description: Library to organize; scanning/organization happens within this library.

recursive.label: Recursive
recursive.description: Override library recursive setting; None keeps the library default.

patterns.label: Patterns
patterns.description: Override library patterns; None keeps the library default.

path.label: Path
path.description: Directory to scan (overrides library path, must be a subdirectory of the library).

write_nfo.label: Write NFO
write_nfo.description: Override the library NFO setting; None keeps the library default.

copy_resources.label: Copy on organize
copy_resources.description: Override which sidecars are copied onto library paths; None keeps the library default.

number.label: Number
number.description: Content ID (e.g., MIDV-123). May be sent alone, or together with Media ID: both fields scrape this number and attach the file.

media_id.label: Media ID
media_id.description: MediaFile ID. Alone, the server parses the number from the file path; together with Number, this field only attaches the file.

content_type.label: Content Type
content_type.description: Media content category — determines crawler routing.

use_cache.label: Use Cache
use_cache.description: Checked caches are reused; unchecked means force-refresh that kind.

max_dim_threshold.label: Max Dimension Threshold
max_dim_threshold.description: Only upscale images whose longest side is below this value.

max_bytes_threshold.label: Max File Size Threshold (bytes)
max_bytes_threshold.description: Files larger than this skip upscaling (treated as sharp enough).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of images to upscale.

library_id.label: Library
library_id.description: Library to refresh; scanning/organization happens within this library.

recursive.label: Recursive
recursive.description: Override library recursive setting; None keeps the library default.

patterns.label: Patterns
patterns.description: Override library patterns; None keeps the library default.

path.label: Path
path.description: Directory to scan (overrides library path, must be a subdirectory of the library).

force.label: Force Reimport
force.description: Ignore the stored dump ETag and re-download/import unconditionally.

actor_id.label: Actor ID
actor_id.description: Primary key of the Actor entity.

use_cache.label: Use cache
use_cache.description: Checked kinds are reused; unchecked kinds are force-refreshed.

limit.label: Batch size
limit.description: Max metadata entries per run (least recently updated first; keeps the worker queue short).

min_age_days.label: Min age (days)
min_age_days.description: Only rescrape entries last updated more than this many days ago; leave empty for no threshold.
